name: MRI-actuated cath.
versions: single-coil-set prototype in 2025 kinematics paper; earlier design papers cited (refs 5-7 of hao2025, not read)
target_anatomy: cardiac EP (atrial fibrillation ablation under real-time MRI)
devices_driven: own catheter: rigid actuator segment with one axial and two side coils between flexible segments
n_dof_detail: 3 coil currents per actuator (one coil set in the prototype)
translation_detail: magnetic (MRI scanner static field acts on current-carrying coils); insertion length is an input
imaging_compat: MRI-actuated and MR-guided by design; catadioptric stereo camera used in bench tests
validation_detail: open-loop complex tip trajectories tracked by stereo camera; no phantom with flow
sim_model: static Cosserat rod with analytical Jacobians, real-time (hao2025_realtime, abstract + method)
sim2real_detail: model-based: kinematic model used for open-loop control of the prototype; no learned policy
